plugins.name: piping-toolset
plugins.description: ASME B31.1 / B31.3 piping skills from PipingToolset (pipingtoolset.com): pressure design, stress screening, CAESAR II / AutoPIPE load cases, PDF isometric to CAESAR II PCF, and pipe support structural checks (AISC 360-22, ACI 318-19, ASCE 7-22) with review and optimization. No ASME code table values are embedded.
